name: reverseport
description: Reverse engineer anything. Port it anywhere. MCP server, CLI and skills for AI coding agents: read Godot .pck, Unity IL2CPP, .NET and native binaries (through your own Ghidra, IDA or Hopper), compare builds, keep proof for every claim, and port games between Godot, Unity, Unreal, three.js and languages with parity checks.
